memory_verse.label: Bible Portion
memory_verse.text: "On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled. Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead. Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, 'Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad'" - Gen 31:22-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
When Laban discovers that Jacob has fled, he gathers his men and gives chase, pursuing for seven days until he catches up. Laban is angry and powerful, and Jacob is vulnerable — travelling slowly with women, children, and flocks. Humanly speaking, Jacob is in danger. But before Laban can act, God steps in. He comes to Laban in a dream and warns him: "Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad."

God stood guard over Jacob. The very night before the confrontation, the Lord went ahead and restrained Laban, tying his hands before he could do harm. Jacob may not even have known the danger he was in — but God was already protecting him.

This is a wonderful picture of how God watches over His people. Often we have no idea what dangers God has quietly turned aside on our behalf. He works behind the scenes, restraining threats, softening hearts, closing doors we never see. As the psalmist says, the One who watches over us "will neither slumber nor sleep" (Ps 121:4).

You may feel exposed and vulnerable today, unsure how a difficult confrontation or situation will go. Take heart: God can go ahead of you and prepare the way. He is able to protect you in ways you cannot see, and He never takes His eyes off His children.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Do you trust that God is protecting you, even in unseen ways?
Where do you feel exposed and in need of God going ahead of you?
How might God already be at work in a situation you are dreading?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You watch over me and never slumber. Go ahead of me into the situations I fear, and protect me in ways I cannot see. I trust myself to Your care. Amen.
